# AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate (DEA-C01)

> Self-contained study material for one exam: AWS DEA-C01, structured as
> a 10-day intensive sprint (~50 hours). Dense long-form markdown
> reference: keyword-to-service mapping, decision trees, exam traps, and
> practice questions with full option-by-option explanations.
>
> Scope note: this index covers `AWS/AWSDEA/` only. Other exam folders in
> this repository are independent and have their own `llms.txt`.

Agents: read `CLAUDE.md` in this folder (identical to `GEMINI.md` and
`AGENTS.md`) before making changes. It documents the 8-step teaching
structure, the just-in-time file generation rule, and the AWS service
renames that must be maintained.

## Core reference (written in full)

- [Decision trees](00-START-HERE/DECISION-TREES.md): 16 service-selection trees plus 17 worked exam questions with every option dissected
- [Service selection matrix](00-START-HERE/SERVICE-SELECTION-MATRIX.md): ~110 keyword-to-service triggers and 16 comparison matrices
- [Exam guide](00-START-HERE/EXAM-GUIDE.md): all 17 DEA-C01 task statements, in-scope service list with depth ratings, self-assessment checklist
- [Exam traps](00-START-HERE/EXAM-TRAPS.md): 60 recurring distractors in setup-wrong-right-principle format
- [10-day plan](00-START-HERE/10-DAY-PLAN.md): daily schedule with spaced repetition on days 2, 4, 5, 8, 10
- [Mnemonics](00-START-HERE/MNEMONICS.md): memory hooks for services, pipelines, and IAM evaluation order
- [Exam strategy](00-START-HERE/EXAM-STRATEGY.md): time management across 130 minutes, elimination heuristics
- [50 tips](00-START-HERE/50-TIPS.md): original tip list audited and re-weighted for the 2026 exam

## Index

- [Folder index](README.md): master mental map and reading order
